description: Keeps the digest-pinned Fedora base and the npm-pinned CLIs current. Requires the Renovate GitHub app on this repo. CLAUDE_VERSION and CLAUDE_BINARY_SHA256 in containers/agent-base/Containerfile are bumped by hand: the binary hash has to be re-derived from the release manifest, which Renovate cannot do.

packageRules.description: Base image: follow Fedora 44 by digest only; a major bump is a deliberate decision recorded in AUDIT.md.
agent-base:latest is built locally, never fetched from a registry.
